Introduction & Purpose
1
Why Does This SOP Exist?
This SOP aims to standardize how Methaq Takaful Insurance call center agents
handle customer calls related to motor insurance policies and claims. Its
objectives are:
Reduce inaccurate or inconsistent information provided to customers
Reduce unnecessary escalations to the Claims Department
Increase first-call resolution rate
Ensure every agent, regardless of experience, follows the same procedure
The Golden Rule: Never guess. Always check the system before speaking. If you don't
know the answer, tell the customer you will check — never make up an answer.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
8
Q1 – I have Comprehensive insurance — will my car be repaired even if I caused the
accident?
:Answer
.Yes. Comprehensive insurance repairs the policyholder's vehicle regardless of fault
The customer only needs to notify Methaq of the claim and submit the required
.documents (police report, driving license, Mulkiya, Emirates ID)

Intentional damage
Q2 – I have Third-Party insurance and another driver hit me — will Methaq repair my
car?
Answer:
No. Third-Party insurance never covers the policyholder's own vehicle.
Since the other driver is at fault, their insurance must pay repair costs, and the claim must
be submitted to the other driver's insurer.
Q3 – I have Third-Party insurance and caused the accident — what happens?
Answer:
Methaq will pay for the other party's vehicle/property damage, whether that party is a
Methaq customer or not.
Methaq will NOT repair the at-fault policyholder's vehicle under Third-Party coverage.

regardless of fault.
A Methaq customer's car is hit by an unknown driver while parked. Since they

Insurance that only pays for damage the policyholder causes to others'
